new_content.name: Swift Flight
new_content.how_to_obtain: About 8% chance in End City chests.
new_content.notes: Levels I-III give 40%, 60% and 80% faster flight. Applies to happy ghast harnesses.

getting_started: Find the book in End Cities and apply it to a harness at an anvil.
editor_notes: A datapack (jodek namespace) packaged as a mod; 15 functions and 3 advancements. Verify in-game that the pack's enchantment tweaks (universal-enchants, removeenchantmentincompatibility) do not conflict.
name: Swift Flight
summary: Adds the Swift Flight enchantment for happy ghast harnesses. Each level increases happy ghast flight speed.
